- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.

Version 1.0.2 of crazyrouter-tts

- No file changes detected; documentation and functionality remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Updated API key check command for improved reliability.
- Changed all usage examples from `bun` to `tsx` for script execution.
- No other feature or option changes.

Initial release: Text-to-speech via Crazyrouter API

- Convert text to natural-sounding speech using OpenAI TTS voices (alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer).
- Supports text input, input from files, speed adjustment, quality selection, and various output formats.
- Requires a Crazyrouter API key to operate.
- Flexible CLI usage for different TTS needs (voice selection, HD model, etc.).
